what: Cross-mode specificity (P0.4.0 / audit C3): the grad-norm divergence instrument must NOT fire on FORGETTING. Reads the pre-clip phase-B grad norm off the P0.3.9 seed-stable SSL-MAE forgetting vehicle (pretrained ViT-B, task A=Imagenette -> task B=CIFAR-100, decoder-first well epochs_a=60/warmup 30 + epochs_b=40, lr=3e-4). Device=hpu, seeds 0/1/2.
reads: Every seed CRATERS (PC BWT -0.065..-0.075, a genuine 3/3 forgetting fire) yet the phase-B grad norm peaks at only ~4.2-8.3 and is ALWAYS finite -> grad norm does NOT fire on forgetting, seed-robustly and ~4 orders of magnitude below the divergence scale (>=1e5).

The PC grad norm (~4-8) is indistinguishable from the healthy arm's (~5-7): forgetting is a slow representation drift, not an optimization instability, so the divergence instrument is correctly blind to it. Closes C3's forgetting leg from predicted-but-unread to shown.
Grad norm captured via the pre-clip return of clip_grad_norm_ in the forgetting harness _train (the P0.3 harness pre-dates the P0.4.0 instrumentation, so the trace had to be added + re-run).
